Your Food Intolerance is an advanced diagnostic programme that is able to identify food groups and specific foods that may be causing your symptoms.
            
The app works by systematically restricting various food groups and individual foods in your diet over a set period and analysing your food intake and any associated symptoms within the designated time interval. Restrictions are designed to allow a varied and reasonable diet within the allotted time frame. Symptoms are measured for their frequency and severity and are categorised as allergic or intolerant.

The app is designed to operate in three stages.
            
Stage I. You will be asked to assign the foods you would typically eat to 1 of the 8 listed food groups. The app contains a comprehensive list of foods contained in each group. You can add foods to these food groups if the food you normally eat is not listed. You will be asked to exclude one food group each day for a set period of time and the results will be analysed. If a suspect food group is identified you may complete the programme or proceed to the next stage.
            
Stage II. If no food group has been identified you will be asked to repeat the programme excluding one food group for seven days.
            
Stage III. If a suspect food group has been identified you will be asked to select the foods from that food group and exclude one of these foods daily as in Stage I.

During the course of the programme, you will be required to enter data PRIOR TO EACH MEAL. You will be asked to enter food groups or foods you are about to consume and identify and quantify any symptoms you experienced from the PREVIOUS MEAL.
